items.title: The Rat
items.summary: The Rat, also known as RAT, is the main antagonist of the Five Nights at Candy's series, acting as the main antagonist of Five Nights at Candy's and Five Nights at Candy's 2.

items.title: Monster Rat
items.summary: Monster Rat is the monstrous version of the Rat conjured in the nightmares of Mary Schmidt.  He is the main antagonist of Five Nights at Candy's 3.

items.title: Monster Vinnie
items.comment: Yeah, no. He's final antagonist to appear. Not the guy caused the whole chaos through the series.
items.summary: Monster Vinnie is a monster version of Vinnie and the final antagonist of Five Nights at Candy's 3.

items.title: Vinnie
items.summary: Vinnie, also called the Reverse Puppet, is the overarching antagonist of the Five Nights at Candy's series, acting as the embodiment of Mary Schmidt's guilt.

items.title: Rat & Cat Theater Actors
items.comment: Undo revision [[Special:Diff/3545269|3545269]] by [[Special:Contributions/Random Half Life Citizen number 27|Random Half Life Citizen number 27]] ([[User talk:Random Half Life Citizen number 27|talk]])
items.summary: The Rat & Cat Theater Actors are actors who perform within the Rat & Cat Theater.  They first appear in Five Nights at Candy's 3.

items.title: The Cat
items.summary: Candy the Cat, also known as The Cat, is the titular secondary antagonist of the Five Nights at Candy's series, acting as the secondary antagonist in Five Nights at Candy's 2 and a major character in Five Nights at Candy's 3.

items.title: The Puppeteer
items.summary: The Puppeteer is an antagonist in the Five Nights at Candy's series.  He was one the founders of the Rat & Cat Theater as well as an actor and puppeteer at the Rat & Cat Theater who controlled Vinnie, his puppet.

items.title: Circus Baby
items.summary: Circus Baby (commonly referred to as Baby) is a Funtime animatronic and the main mascot of Circus Baby's Pizza World invented by Afton Robotics, LLC, made for Fazbear Entertainment, Inc..
